question: Why did the OCR merge (R-010) get refused on most stores?
symptom: store_repair refused the R-010 pages repair: fin_quarter_printed rows from scanned pages are removed and some have no same-value row after (c05 12, c07 3, c08 1, c09 12, c20 4, c21 1). Most removed rows are wrong parses of a jumbled text layer (e.g. GAYAPROJ FY25 standalone total income 3,46,572.20 lakh), but a few look right (SPMLINFRA Q3FY25 PBT 126,517 thousand from 'Profi/lloss) before Excaptional ltems').
cause: Once a page has OCR text the printed-table parser reads only that text; a line the OCR splits or misreads gives no row, and the layer row it replaced is gone.

Review 18 Nov (Eagle, own sample c21+c09, 20 rows; agy Opus review died on its Claude limit): no right row lost (the one XBRL-right lost row is held from another filing); confirmed-and-right rows c21 205->248, c09 406->477; unconfirmed wrong rows c21 67->13, c09 105->39; PASS.

cause: Five general defects in comparatives.py: (1) _xbrl_ok/_xbrl_diff ignored period_type (checking FY against 3M fin_quarter_xbrl instead of fin_annual_line facts, except paid_up_capital stock); (2) _debit_costs returned None on mixed signed costs without keeping confirmed rows or passing xbrl_ok cells; (3) _decimals/_eps_decimals/_tol/_printed_tolerance did not strip trailing ')' on bracketed negatives, _choose_rows took first within tol instead of min XBRL diff, eps agreed tol 0.02 hid 0 vs 0.01, and discontinued-ops tax matched tax; (4) continuation pages dropped fill_table, _split_side_by_side returned None on garbled layer headers, fill_choice roles with None broke set equality, and probe skipped disagreed layer candidates via setdefault; (5) derived tax in probe was not promoted to columns and ocr_pending rows dropped before _apply_repeats.

fix: Updated _xbrl_wants/_xbrl_conflict/_xbrl_diff/_xbrl_ok, _assign_status, _apply_repeats, _has_repeat_match, _choose_rows, _debit_costs, _decimals/_eps_decimals/_tol/_printed_tolerance, _DISCONTINUED_LABEL in match_line, _split_side_by_side, _extract_symbol, and _table_rows in reality_engine/pilot3/comparatives.py; added unit tests per cause in reality_engine/tests/test_pilot3_comparatives.py.
